based_on: SIG-Lite (abbreviated) structure, adapted for this project

questions.text: Is customer/personal data encrypted at rest?
Is customer/personal data encrypted in transit (TLS 1.2+)?
Does the vendor have a documented data retention and deletion policy?
Is data processed or stored outside the UK/EEA?
questions.note: Not automatically disqualifying - requires adequacy/SCC review

questions.text: Is multi-factor authentication enforced for administrative access?
Does the vendor perform periodic access reviews?
Is access provisioned on a least-privilege basis?
Does the vendor have a documented incident response plan?
Does the vendor commit to a breach notification SLA (e.g. within 72 hours)?
Has the vendor experienced a data breach in the last 24 months?
questions.note: Requires review of remediation, not automatically disqualifying

questions.text: Does the vendor have a documented business continuity / disaster recovery plan?
Is the vendor's BC/DR plan tested at least annually?
Does the vendor hold ISO 27001 certification (or equivalent)?
Does the vendor hold a current SOC 2 Type II report?
Is the vendor GDPR compliant (has a DPA available for signature)?
